name: Passing Word of a Threat
summary: In the Badlands, Belgrum sends you back to Karnik with the king's command to act swiftly against the Shadowforge.

sections.title: Belgrum's Answer
sections.body: Belgrum reads Karnik's note to the end. His eyes widen at the evil tidings. He sends you back to Karnik with the king's command: act swiftly and decisively on what is known. The Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands must stop.

sections.title: Karnik's Reply
sections.body: Karnik takes the urgency as the king's own and has a plan ready. The Shadowforge operate from Angor Fortress. A blow there can slow their work in Uldaman.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Karnik?
faq.answer: Advisor Belgrum sends you back after reading Karnik's note. You carry the king's command to act swiftly and decisively.

faq.q: What does Belgrum want done about the Shadowforge?
faq.answer: Belgrum wants Karnik to act quickly and firmly to end the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.

aliases: quest before passing word of a threat
faq.answer: You brought Karnik's sealed note to Advisor Belgrum in the earlier Passing Word of a Threat, after the Prospect of Faith steps.
